reply_text:
I replied to Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the deadline for Thornbury Cloth Co.'s signed order form is **21 December**. Marcus posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and Dana can see that message herself. A date is an operational fact, not a money term, so it was fine to share in the channel.

Nothing in #north-team since then changes the date. The workspace brain turned up nothing on Thornbury. Even the note I saved for Marcus on 14 October didn't come back when I looked it up, so the channel message is the only record. Because of that, I suggested Dana check with Marcus before entering it in the tracker as final.
